de: Unser neuer Verkehrsminister: Viel Lächeln, wenige Antworten. Bundesverkehrsminister Steffen Bilger hat den Auftrag, 170 Milliarden Euro für Schiene und Straße auszugeben. Statt echter Reformen will der Neue die Infrastrukturprobleme Stück für Stück abarbeiten. Kaum zu glauben, dass das für die deutsche Verkehrswende re…
en: Our new transport minister: lots of smiles, few answers. Federal Transport Minister Steffen Bilger is tasked with spending 170 billion euros on rail and road. Instead of real reforms, the new guy wants to work through the infrastructure problems piece by piece. It's hard to believe that this is so important for the German transport transition...
la: Novus minister onerariis nostris: multa ridet, pauca responsa. Minister Transport Steffen Bilger foederatus est 170 miliarda nummorum in railia et via expendendo. Pro reformationibus realibus, novus guy per difficultates infrastructuras per partes operari vult. Difficile est credere quod tam magni momenti est translationi Germanorum.

en: Dispute over route prices: How expensive will the rail toll be? Rising route prices are enraging railway companies and the state transport ministers. They warn that the traffic turnaround will be slowed down.
